type.zh: 机器人边缘计算开发平台
type.en: Robot edge-compute development platform

overview.zh: RDK X5 4GB 是搭载八核 Cortex-A55 与10 TOPS BPU的机器人开发板。本记录区分4GB内存配置，保留官网CPU、存储、多媒体、相机、USB、音频、显示、网络、CAN和扩展接口全部规格项。
overview.en: RDK X5 4GB is a robotics development board with eight Cortex-A55 cores and a 10 TOPS BPU. This record distinguishes the 4GB memory option and retains all published CPU, storage, multimedia, camera, USB, audio, display, network, CAN and expansion-interface fields.

overview.zh: CPU、AI加速器和实时控制单元承担不同任务。公开算力数值不等于任意模型的实际速度，也不包含传感器预处理、传输与执行器响应；在机器人上部署时仍需测量端到端时延与持续散热下的表现。
overview.en: CPU, AI accelerator and real-time controllers serve different workloads. Public compute ratings are not arbitrary-model throughput and exclude sensor preprocessing, transfer and actuator response. Measure end-to-end latency and sustained thermal performance on the target robot.

applications.en: Robot perception, edge AI inference and multi-sensor prototyping

integration.zh: 核对系统镜像、BPU工具链、算子支持、模型量化方式、内存预算、供电与外设电平。模块、开发板与扩展板不可相互替代套用接口表。
integration.en: Check the OS image, BPU toolchain, supported operators, quantization, memory budget, power and peripheral voltage levels. Modules, development boards and expansion boards do not share interchangeable interface specifications.

verification.zh: 判断：开发套件可缩短原型搭建，但量产产品仍需处理结构、热设计、生命周期供货与版本锁定。
verification.en: Assessment: a kit can accelerate prototyping; production still requires mechanical and thermal design, lifecycle supply and revision control.

alt.zh: RDK X5 原厂接口图；内存配置不由照片区分。
alt.en: Official RDK X5 interface image; photograph does not distinguish memory variants.

type.zh: 机器人边缘计算开发平台
type.en: Robot edge-compute development platform

overview.zh: RDK X5 8GB 是搭载八核 Cortex-A55 与10 TOPS BPU的机器人开发板。本记录区分8GB内存配置，保留官网CPU、存储、多媒体、相机、USB、音频、显示、网络、CAN和扩展接口全部规格项。
overview.en: RDK X5 8GB is a robotics development board with eight Cortex-A55 cores and a 10 TOPS BPU. This record distinguishes the 8GB memory option and retains all published CPU, storage, multimedia, camera, USB, audio, display, network, CAN and expansion-interface fields.

overview.zh: CPU、AI加速器和实时控制单元承担不同任务。公开算力数值不等于任意模型的实际速度，也不包含传感器预处理、传输与执行器响应；在机器人上部署时仍需测量端到端时延与持续散热下的表现。
overview.en: CPU, AI accelerator and real-time controllers serve different workloads. Public compute ratings are not arbitrary-model throughput and exclude sensor preprocessing, transfer and actuator response. Measure end-to-end latency and sustained thermal performance on the target robot.

applications.en: Robot perception, edge AI inference and multi-sensor prototyping

integration.zh: 核对系统镜像、BPU工具链、算子支持、模型量化方式、内存预算、供电与外设电平。模块、开发板与扩展板不可相互替代套用接口表。
integration.en: Check the OS image, BPU toolchain, supported operators, quantization, memory budget, power and peripheral voltage levels. Modules, development boards and expansion boards do not share interchangeable interface specifications.

verification.zh: 判断：开发套件可缩短原型搭建，但量产产品仍需处理结构、热设计、生命周期供货与版本锁定。
verification.en: Assessment: a kit can accelerate prototyping; production still requires mechanical and thermal design, lifecycle supply and revision control.

alt.en: Official RDK X5 interface image; photograph does not distinguish memory variants.

type.zh: 机器人边缘计算开发平台
type.en: Robot edge-compute development platform

overview.zh: RDK S100 使用 Cortex-A78AE CPU、Nash BPU和Cortex-R52+ MCU的异构架构。该配置为80 TOPS INT8等效AI算力、12GB LPDDR5内存，CPU主频1.5GHz；它与另一S100配置分别记录，避免把128 TOPS和24GB混入基础版。
overview.en: RDK S100 combines Cortex-A78AE CPUs, a Nash BPU and Cortex-R52+ MCUs. This configuration provides 80 TOPS INT8-equivalent AI compute, 12GB LPDDR5 and a 1.5GHz CPU clock. The two S100 configurations are kept separate rather than assigning the higher option’s 128 TOPS and 24GB to the base board.

overview.zh: CPU、AI加速器和实时控制单元承担不同任务。公开算力数值不等于任意模型的实际速度，也不包含传感器预处理、传输与执行器响应；在机器人上部署时仍需测量端到端时延与持续散热下的表现。
overview.en: CPU, AI accelerator and real-time controllers serve different workloads. Public compute ratings are not arbitrary-model throughput and exclude sensor preprocessing, transfer and actuator response. Measure end-to-end latency and sustained thermal performance on the target robot.

applications.zh: 机器人感知、边缘AI推理与多传感器原型开发
applications.en: Robot perception, edge AI inference and multi-sensor prototyping

integration.zh: 核对系统镜像、BPU工具链、算子支持、模型量化方式、内存预算、供电与外设电平。模块、开发板与扩展板不可相互替代套用接口表。
integration.en: Check the OS image, BPU toolchain, supported operators, quantization, memory budget, power and peripheral voltage levels. Modules, development boards and expansion boards do not share interchangeable interface specifications.

verification.zh: 判断：开发套件可缩短原型搭建，但量产产品仍需处理结构、热设计、生命周期供货与版本锁定。
verification.en: Assessment: a kit can accelerate prototyping; production still requires mechanical and thermal design, lifecycle supply and revision control.

type.zh: 机器人边缘计算开发平台
type.en: Robot edge-compute development platform

overview.zh: RDK S100P 使用 Cortex-A78AE CPU、Nash BPU和Cortex-R52+ MCU的异构架构。该配置为128 TOPS INT8等效AI算力、24GB LPDDR5内存，CPU主频2GHz；它与另一S100配置分别记录，避免把128 TOPS和24GB混入基础版。
overview.en: RDK S100P combines Cortex-A78AE CPUs, a Nash BPU and Cortex-R52+ MCUs. This configuration provides 128 TOPS INT8-equivalent AI compute, 24GB LPDDR5 and a 2GHz CPU clock. The two S100 configurations are kept separate rather than assigning the higher option’s 128 TOPS and 24GB to the base board.

overview.zh: CPU、AI加速器和实时控制单元承担不同任务。公开算力数值不等于任意模型的实际速度，也不包含传感器预处理、传输与执行器响应；在机器人上部署时仍需测量端到端时延与持续散热下的表现。
overview.en: CPU, AI accelerator and real-time controllers serve different workloads. Public compute ratings are not arbitrary-model throughput and exclude sensor preprocessing, transfer and actuator response. Measure end-to-end latency and sustained thermal performance on the target robot.

overview.en: RDK X3 includes a development board, Module and carrier board. The current page gives a shared 5 TOPS Cortex-A53 specification, but switching the three labels does not change its parameter text. This is therefore a family record, not an assignment of every interface or eMMC option to each SKU.

overview.zh: CPU、AI加速器和实时控制单元承担不同任务。公开算力数值不等于任意模型的实际速度，也不包含传感器预处理、传输与执行器响应；在机器人上部署时仍需测量端到端时延与持续散热下的表现。
overview.en: CPU, AI accelerator and real-time controllers serve different workloads. Public compute ratings are not arbitrary-model throughput and exclude sensor preprocessing, transfer and actuator response. Measure end-to-end latency and sustained thermal performance on the target robot.

role.zh: 机器人计算平台与开发生态供应商

overview.zh: 地瓜机器人的RDK产品线面向机器人与边缘智能开发，提供计算板、模块、附件及开发工具。其公司介绍覆盖人形机器人、陪伴机器人、扫地机器人和割草机器人等合作方向，因此不能把它简单归类成某一种机器人整机制造商。
overview.en: D-Robotics supplies RDK compute boards, modules, accessories and development tools for robotics and edge intelligence. Its company introduction describes work across humanoids, companion robots, vacuum cleaners and lawn mowers; it is not simply a manufacturer of one robot form.

overview.zh: 公开硬件目录包括X3系列、X5及S100系列。X3侧重5 TOPS平台，X5升级到10 TOPS并扩展相机、CAN FD和网络接口，S100系列进一步分为80和128 TOPS INT8等效算力配置，并加入独立MCU承担实时控制工作。内存容量和CPU频率必须与具体型号对应。
overview.en: The public hardware catalog includes X3, X5 and S100 families. X3 provides a 5 TOPS platform; X5 provides 10 TOPS with expanded camera, CAN FD and network interfaces. S100 configurations offer 80 or 128 TOPS INT8-equivalent compute and an MCU for real-time control. Memory and CPU frequency must match the specific model.

overview.zh: 软件侧包含RDK Studio和NodeHub。前者定位为开发工作台，后者提供节点、算法及应用案例入口；它们是围绕板卡的开发支持，不等于机器人整机已有可验收的完整任务能力。合作伙伴附件也不应全部标成地瓜机器人自制产品。
overview.en: The software ecosystem includes the RDK Studio development workbench and NodeHub nodes, algorithms and application examples. These support board development rather than establishing complete robot-task capabilities. Partner accessories should not all be labeled as D-Robotics-manufactured products.

overview.zh: 选型需要同时审视AI算子覆盖、量化精度、实时系统、外设同步和部署工具链。不同数值精度下的TOPS不能直接相加或排序；开发板支持一个模型也不自动说明最终应用满足时延、功耗与安全要求。
overview.en: Selection involves AI operator coverage, quantization, real-time systems, peripheral synchronization and deployment tooling. TOPS at different numeric precisions are not directly additive or comparable. Model support does not establish application latency, power or safety compliance.
